name: deep-research
title: Research a question and write a sourced report

origin.source: Open Deep Research and Gemini Fullstack LangGraph research loops

comparison.purpose: Plans several complementary searches and runs them at the same time; then Jev judges whether the findings answer the question, and a choice state either writes the report (sufficient) or spends the one follow-up round the budget allows, aimed at what the findings leave out. The output says which rule ended it. Researchers run real web search, and a cited page enters the source ledger only if the search actually returned it.

starters: What are the leading approaches to long-context LLMs in 2026?
How do carbon-capture startups actually remove CO2?
What is the state of solid-state batteries for EVs?
